recovery_scope_note: Minimal two-method design cannot reproduce the earlier Frozen/Always-FT reference envelope. Fresh recovery is frozen here as a V2-to-V1 relative diagnostic and is never pooled with development recovery estimates.
relative_verification_safety: persistent/replay harmful and downside paired CIs must not be wholly above zero
benign_regression: no stationary/gradual/abrupt/recurring lifecycle-MSE paired CI wholly above zero
plasticity_success: at least one of beneficial recall CI wholly above zero, relative excess-loss-area CI wholly below zero, censored-recovery CI wholly below zero, or recovery-time CI wholly below zero

verdicts.CONFIRMED: primary CI upper<0; all absolute risks pass; verification relative safety passes; no benign-regime adverse MSE CI; at least one plasticity endpoint clearly favorable
verdicts.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: all absolute risks pass, primary point is favorable, but a required relative/plasticity/regime condition is inconclusive or locally adverse
verdicts.NOT_CONFIRMED: any absolute risk fails; primary MSE CI wholly adverse; or at least two benign-regime lifecycle-MSE CIs are wholly adverse while the primary point estimate is non-favorable (>=0)

replay_discordance.fresh_rule: A if either fresh harmful/downside CI is wholly adverse; B if neither is wholly adverse and both point differences are <=0; C otherwise

other_baselines: prior/development/V1 evidence only; no fresh paired claims
